title: Voronoi nearest-point interaction
intent: Partition a scatterplot into nearest-point regions and reveal the closest typed datum in two dimensions.

source.title: Observable Plot Voronoi and pointer interactions

ai.create: Create a colored Voronoi scatterplot with native two-dimensional nearest-point tooltips. Use Plot's voronoi and pointer primitives and granular d3-delaunay at the TanStack composition boundary.
ai.maintain: Move or add points while retaining bounded cells, stable dot identity, matching color domains, typed tooltip rows, responsive recomputation, and keyboard focus without importing spatial code into the shared renderer.
